acceptance_met: Seeded synthetic log: record content is a pure function of (seed, partition, offset) — 16B key (partition+offset+hash fragment), value (offset ID + splitmix hash + filler), N headers (h{i} + seeded values); records/batch, payload size, header count, partitions, codec and abort ratio are CLI-configurable; batches generated deterministically on demand (bounded log, zero storage).
max_bytes and partition_max_bytes honored (whole batches, one-batch progress guarantee); responses are immediate (min_bytes/max_wait documented approximation); consumer verified compatible.

Unknown topic ids -> UNKNOWN_TOPIC_ID (100), negative offsets -> OFFSET_OUT_OF_RANGE (1), malformed frames close only that connection (interop-proven, server survives); artifact labeled client-ceiling with fetch_requests/fetched_records/fetched_wire_bytes.
commands: cargo test --locked --manifest-path benchmarks/nullbroker/Cargo.toml (19 unit + 3 interop passed)
cargo clippy --locked --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings (clean incl. bench_fetch VERIFY)
bench_fetch VERIFY=1 x6 runs vs nullbroker (see measurements): all mismatches 0, all reconciled
limits: Compressed codecs are valid stored frames (stored deflate blocks, xerial literal-only raw blocks, uncompressed LZ4 blocks): real client decoders run, but compression math/entropy is not representative.
On-demand generation deviates from 'pre-encoded ... from memory' deliberately: identical bytes, unbounded-with-budget log, no storage; min_bytes/max_wait answer immediately.
bench_fetch gained VERIFY/SEED/VERIFY_HEADERS/ISOLATION env (additive); SEED/VERIFY_HEADERS must match server flags.
Throughput numbers are informational pre-KL09-02 loopback figures (n=1), not claims per the KL09-01 freeze.

measurements.reconcile: every run: server fetched == client consumed (+ gap-fill exact on the abort run); per-record ID/hash/key/header/filler all verified
